name: Automated Backup
description: Scheduled account backups with per-account locks, verification, upload to configured destinations, day/week/month retention of the local archives, a run history and token-confirmed restores.

fields.label: Packages
fields.help: Used when "Back up" is set to packages; unknown names are reported as run warnings.

fields.label: Accounts
fields.help: Used when "Back up" is set to accounts; unknown usernames are reported as run warnings.

fields.label: Verify each archive after it is written
Request encrypted archives
fields.help: This panel version only produces gzip-compressed, unencrypted archives: when the host refuses (UNSUPPORTED) the archive is written unencrypted and the run carries a warning.

fields.label: Schedule (UTC cron)
fields.help: Leave empty to disable scheduled runs; "Run now" still works.

fields.label: Monthly archives to keep
fields.help: Retention removes local archives only; copies on a destination follow that destination's own retention.

fields.label: Destination ids
fields.help: Ids from the Destinations page (Backup › Backup Configuration). Unknown ids are skipped with a run warning.

fields.label: Per-account lock TTL (minutes)
fields.help: A lock left behind by an interrupted run expires after this long.

run.label: Run backups
run.description: Back up the selected accounts now: create, verify, upload to every destination, record, then apply retention.

prune.label: Apply retention
prune.description: Delete local archives outside the daily/weekly/monthly retention buckets.

restore.label: Restore an archive
restore.description: Restore an archive over an account; needs a confirm token from POST /api/plugins/manage/net.whm.automated-backup/restore-token.

pages.title: Automated Backup settings
pages.description: Account selection, schedule, retention, destinations and notifications.

pages.title: Backup history
pages.description: Scheduled and manual runs, host-initiated backups, prunes and restores.

pages.title: Backup destinations
pages.description: Destinations configured in Backup Configuration; copy an id into the Destination ids setting.

pages.title: Archives
pages.description: Archives known to Automated Backup (own and host-initiated) with their local and remote state.

pages.title: Account locks
pages.description: Accounts currently locked by a run; release a stale lock with POST /locks/:account/release.

pages.title: Run backups now
pages.description: Starts a backup run for the configured accounts.

pages.title: Restore an archive
pages.description: Restores an archive over an account. The confirm token comes from POST /api/plugins/manage/net.whm.automated-backup/restore-token { artefactId, account }.

fields.label: Confirm token
fields.help: Single-use, issued to root for exactly this archive and account.
